exposure: Group B Streptococcus colonisation of the lower genital tract
cohort: Women who underwent emergent intrapartum cesarean section and had uterine cultures performed
finding: Positive uterine cultures were identified in 15% of emergent CS and correlated with prolonged ROM.
mod_finding: Positive uterine cultures were identified in 15% of emergent cesarean sections and correlated with prolonged ROM.
